task_prompt:
Create a complete, polished, standalone GUI-based Sudoku game in Python using CustomTkinter inside the workspace. The application must feature:
1. Three selectable difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) with procedurally generated or algorithmically sliced valid boards.
2. An interactive 9x9 grid with input handling, cell highlighting, and real-time validation for invalid duplicate entries.
3. Clean architecture split into logic (sudoku_logic.py), GUI presentation (sudoku_app.py), automated test suite (test_sudoku.py), and entrypoint (main.py).
4. Full autonomous delivery: Write all files completely with zero placeholder stubs (# TODO), execute local tests to verify board generation/solvability, and issue TERMINATE once fully operational.
